subject: Turning your dead leads list back into bookings
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most mobile and in-home vet practices have a “dead” leads list — people who inquired months ago, went quiet, and never got a real follow-up. Most of those leads aren't actually dead.


An AI reactivation sequence can text and email every old lead automatically on a set cadence — no manual dialing, no spreadsheet tracking. It stops the moment someone replies, so it never feels like spam. Practices running this typically see 10–15% of “dead” leads respond and book within two weeks, simply because they finally got a nudge at the right moment. Zero extra hours of manual outreach — the list works itself while you focus on calls that are already booked.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call — schedule here


Dylan | Digigrowth
